Messages.Author: Amberan
Messages.Body:
Hi,

I have a question about Force of Will and the course of action:

A tapped minion A with 1 blood plays Force of Will (on minor [for]).

[Action
Fortitude
1 blood
[for] Only usable by a tapped vampire. (D) Bleed with +1 bleed. This
vampire takes 2 points of aggravated damage (damage not preventable),
even if the action is blocked. Damage occurs after the action or
combat
is resolved.
[FOR] As above, but the (D) bleed is at +2 bleed and the acting
vampire
takes 1 point of aggravated damage (damage not preventable). ]

Some prey's minion B attempts to block. And now the interesting part
comes:

If the minion A plays e.g. Spectral Divination

[Action Modifier/Reaction]
Necromancy
1 Blood
[nec] [ACTION MODIFIER] +1 stealth.
[NEC] [REACTION] +1 intercept.]

to gain +1 stealth, he pays the 1 blood he has. Action remains
unblocked.
Now will the aggravated damage from Force of Will occur, even if the
minion A now does not have the blood to pay it?

Thanks a lot.

Amberan

Messages.Author: Amberan
Messages.Body:
Great, thanks a lot.

Now another situation - if the minion A does not play the stealth, so
combat begins. Minion B moves to long range and does no damage. Combat
ends.

Now - the minion A still have that 1 blood. Will he pay the 1 blood
for the Force of Will and thus be burned (minor fortitude, 2
aggravated damage, first sends him to torpor, second burns him) or
will he keep the 1 blood and thus stay in torpor with no blood (minor
fortitude, 2 aggravated damage, first sends him to torpor, second
takes the last blood)?

Thanks.

David

> Now - the minion A still have that 1 blood. Will he pay the 1 blood

The action was unsuccessful, so the cost wasn't paid.
He keeps his blood, and takes 2 agg damage, so he's in torpor empty.
